entries.name: TP When HP
entries.description: Tests hp_below at 0.5, at its 1.0 maximum (true unless at full HP) and at 0.0 (never true).

entries.name: TP When Underdog
entries.description: Tests the underdog condition both ways: Speed x1.5 while outnumbered, Special Attack x1.1 while not.

entries.name: TP When Field Sides
entries.description: Tests the field condition with side own (Charged on its side) and side enemy (Soaked on the foe's side).

entries.name: TP Aura Stat
entries.description: Tests an ally aura (scope allies): every creature on its side gets Physical Defense x1.2.

entries.name: TP Aura Underdog Power
entries.description: Tests an ally aura with a when condition checked on the holder: allies' Electric moves hit 20% harder while outnumbered.

entries.name: TP Aura Shelter
entries.description: Tests an ally aura of protections: allies are sheltered from Haunted and can't be Dazed.
